AboutPage.heroTitle: Built on Speed, Honesty & Complete Data Privacy
AboutPage.heroSubtitle: Headquartered at Sadashiv Peth, QuickFix was founded to free Pune residents from frustrating service center queues, dishonest quotes, and days without their phone.
AboutPage.storyTitle: The QuickFix Story: Born in Sadashiv Peth
AboutPage.storySubtitle: Transforming mobile repair into a delightful 30-minute doorstep experience.
AboutPage.storyP1: Founded in 2021 by master technician Samadhan Patil, QuickFix was built to solve Pune's biggest repair headache: crowded markets, 5–7 day delays, and data privacy fears.
AboutPage.storyP2: We replaced the hassle with certified doorstep service. Today, our technicians collect your device, repair it with genuine OEM parts in our Sadashiv Peth lab, and return it the same day — with zero password required.
AboutPage.pillarsTitle: The 4 Pillars of Our Doorstep Service
AboutPage.pillarsSubtitle: Our non-negotiable promises to every smartphone owner across Pune.
AboutPage.pillar1Desc: No passwords or data resets. Devices travel in sealed pouches under strict privacy protocols.
AboutPage.pillar2Desc: Collected from your doorstep, repaired in our certified lab, and delivered back same-day.
AboutPage.pillar3Desc: Certified OEM-grade parts backed by a hassle-free 90-day replacement warranty.
AboutPage.pillar4Desc: Upfront transparent pricing with zero travel fees. If we can't fix it, you pay ₹0.
AboutPage.standardsTitle: Our Pune Repair Standards & Diagnostics Lab
AboutPage.standardsSubtitle: Static-controlled central lab in Sadashiv Peth supporting our mobile on-site fleet.
AboutPage.standard1Desc: Screens, batteries, and camera modules are pre-screened on live diagnostic rigs before dispatch.
AboutPage.standard2Desc: Anti-static stations, precision thermal debonding, and zero static discharge risk.
AboutPage.standard3Desc: Tamper-evident sealed pouches, official intake receipts, and zero password access.
AboutPage.founderSubtitle: The technician's craft behind Pune's trusted repair service.
AboutPage.founderBio: With 10+ years in micro-soldering and smartphone architecture, Samadhan founded QuickFix on three principles: genuine part quality, transparent rates, and total customer trust.
AboutPage.founderQuote: Your smartphone carries your work, memories, and life. We treat every device with the exact care and privacy we would expect for our own.
AboutPage.zonesSubtitle: Stationed across 5 regional hubs for express 25 to 45 minute dispatch anywhere in the city.
AboutPage.ctaSubtitle: Book a certified master technician to your home or office anywhere in Pune in under 2 minutes.
AboutPage.guarantee1: No password or data wipe required
AboutPage.guarantee3: Pay only after inspecting touch & display
